cta: Got an internet bill eating your wallet right now? YES or NO 👉
points: 1."Hi, I'd like to lower my internet bill. What retention offers are available?"
2."I've been loyal for three years, but my bill just went up again."
3."A competitor offers the same speed for thirty dollars less."
4."Can you match that price — or should I start canceling?"
5."Are there any loyalty discounts you can apply today?"
6."Please confirm the new rate and the exact start date."
7."Great — I'll stay if you lock this price for twelve months."
